integrity: The claimed theorem is justified by an analytical spectral argument and supported by reproducible finite consistency checks. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform statement for equal-order generalized hexagons with \(q\ge100\); excludes smaller orders, unequal orders and other generalized polygons. Numerical small-order checks do not prove their general case. Historical priority is not independently certified.
title: Fifth-power collapse of Hilbert snowflake thresholds in generalized-hexagon incidence metrics
